claims.statement: Site-admin navigation opens Advanced Security Committers, with a fallback to the top-level admin page if absent. This is a contextual privileged UI route, not a permission grant or measured committer count.

Included-usage controls automatically cap cost-center AI credits at the amount funded by its assigned licenses, adjusting with licensed membership; the user does not enter an amount. At exhaustion the configured choice is blocking members or allowing paid overage. An included cap is not inherently a total-spend stop or proof of an approved overage choice.

The parent article's applicability is limited to existing annual Copilot Pro or Pro Plus subscribers remaining on legacy premium-request billing after June 1, 2026. This qualifier excludes a blanket application to all subscribers and is not live account classification.

Payment-information navigation distinguishes personal, organization and enterprise accounts, then exposes full payment details. Card/PayPal edit or removal differs from Azure subscription edit/removal controls; the linked Azure procedure remains separate. These are conditional instructions, not authorized access or performed changes.

The payment-method notes preserve temporary authorization holds after updates or significant metered usage, paid-subscription cancellation at the next renewal after removal, prohibition on removal during an active paid trial, and removal prerequisites of zero balance and no billable current-month usage or unpaid previous-month usage. No payment removal, cancellation or financial receipt is inferred.

Marketplace downgrade navigation selects the intended app and organization, Change plan then the account plan dropdown. This does not establish the resulting plan, effective timing, credits or authority to downgrade.

Marketplace upgrade navigation follows the same app/organization and plan-edit route as downgrade, with distinct intent. Shared UI is not semantic equivalence of outcomes or approval of additional charges.

Metered licensing distinguishes currently consumed licenses from unique billable licenses in the cycle; a departing user's adjustment is reflected next month, and mid-cycle starts are prorated. The four-day example adds 10 then 20 and removes 5, yielding 25 consumed but 30 billable licenses; it is synthetic, not actual usage. Enterprise organization pending invitations do not consume licenses. Conditional wording switches license versus licensed seat without proving live terms.

Enterprise navigation offers a settings/enterprises example link containing marketing query parameters. It is a route to an enterprise, not a verified selected tenant, membership or consent to billing operations.
